meta.title: Fragrance By Your Side
meta.description: An evanescent scent sparks echoes of memories, and every ripple is dyed in your shade.

units.rawText: Are you preparing for field work?
units.displayText: Are you preparing for field work?

spans.text: Are you preparing for field work?

units.rawText: Yes, the Sanctifier patrols have changed patterns. Many of the routes we mapped out earlier are no longer safe, and it's straining our supplies. We must establish new routes as soon as possible.
units.displayText: Yes, the Sanctifier patrols have changed patterns. Many of the routes we mapped out earlier are no longer safe, and it's straining our supplies. We must establish new routes as soon as possible.

spans.text: Yes, the Sanctifier patrols have changed patterns. Many of the routes we mapped out earlier are no longer safe, and it's straining our supplies. We must establish new routes as soon as possible.

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers are getting more active indeed. That's concerning...
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers are getting more active indeed. That's concerning...

spans.text: The Sanctifiers are getting more active indeed. That's concerning...

units.rawText: The good luck you mentioned is running out, it seems.
units.displayText: The good luck you mentioned is running out, it seems.

spans.text: The good luck you mentioned is running out, it seems.

units.rawText: Don't say it like that.
units.displayText: Don't say it like that.

spans.text: Don't say it like that.

units.rawText: I thought she'd humor my self-deprecating remark, but she seems unusually serious this time.
units.displayText: I thought she'd humor my self-deprecating remark, but she seems unusually serious this time.

spans.text: I thought she'd humor my self-deprecating remark, but she seems unusually serious this time.

units.rawText: I hope your scouting goes well and smooth. Where are you going though? I can't go with you, but maybe I can provide a bit of information.
units.displayText: I hope your scouting goes well and smooth. Where are you going though? I can't go with you, but maybe I can provide a bit of information.

spans.text: I hope your scouting goes well and smooth. Where are you going though? I can't go with you, but maybe I can provide a bit of information.

units.rawText: There appears to be some resources near the Pierides Sector. I plan to check it out with Sol. We don't know much about that sector except that its volume is relatively small.
units.displayText: There appears to be some resources near the Pierides Sector. I plan to check it out with Sol. We don't know much about that sector except that its volume is relatively small.

spans.text: There appears to be some resources near the Pierides Sector. I plan to check it out with Sol. We don't know much about that sector except that its volume is relatively small.

units.rawText: Near the Pierides Sector, huh...
units.displayText: Near the Pierides Sector, huh...

spans.text: Near the Pierides Sector, huh...

units.rawText: Sangoma thinks as she marks spots on the map.
units.displayText: Sangoma thinks as she marks spots on the map.

spans.text: Sangoma thinks as she marks spots on the map.

units.rawText: The resources you need are more likely to be in those spots. Check them out when you pass by.
units.displayText: The resources you need are more likely to be in those spots. Check them out when you pass by.

spans.text: The resources you need are more likely to be in those spots. Check them out when you pass by.

units.rawText: I didn't expect you to know about the Pierides Sector... Thank you for the information, Sangoma.
units.displayText: I didn't expect you to know about the Pierides Sector... Thank you for the information, Sangoma.

spans.text: I didn't expect you to know about the Pierides Sector... Thank you for the information, Sangoma.

units.rawText: That's all the help I can give. Like you said, Sanctifiers in that area are more active and their patterns are less predictable. You're likely to run into them face-to-face at any time.
units.displayText: That's all the help I can give. Like you said, Sanctifiers in that area are more active and their patterns are less predictable. You're likely to run into them face-to-face at any time.

spans.text: That's all the help I can give. Like you said, Sanctifiers in that area are more active and their patterns are less predictable. You're likely to run into them face-to-face at any time.

units.rawText: The sachet I gave you—do you have it with you now?
units.displayText: The sachet I gave you—do you have it with you now?

spans.text: The sachet I gave you—do you have it with you now?

units.rawText: Yeah, I keep it with me all the time.
units.displayText: Yeah, I keep it with me all the time.

spans.text: Yeah, I keep it with me all the time.

units.rawText: Good. Send me an SOS with it if you're in danger, I'll be there in no time.
units.displayText: Good. Send me an SOS with it if you're in danger, I'll be there in no time.

spans.text: Good. Send me an SOS with it if you're in danger, I'll be there in no time.

units.rawText: ...Understood.
units.displayText: ...Understood.

spans.text: ...Understood.

units.rawText: Noticing the weariness on my face, the purple-haired Doll offers her usual warm smile and steps to my side.
units.displayText: Noticing the weariness on my face, the purple-haired Doll offers her usual warm smile and steps to my side.

spans.text: Noticing the weariness on my face, the purple-haired Doll offers her usual warm smile and steps to my side.

units.rawText: Come on, relax. I'll make dinner for you tonight, so don't forget to come back early.
units.displayText: Come on, relax. I'll make dinner for you tonight, so don't forget to come back early.

spans.text: Come on, relax. I'll make dinner for you tonight, so don't forget to come back early.

units.rawText: Alright, let's lighten the mood with a little quiz. Do you remember the species of flower inside the sachet?
units.displayText: Alright, let's lighten the mood with a little quiz. Do you remember the species of flower inside the sachet?

spans.text: Alright, let's lighten the mood with a little quiz. Do you remember the species of flower inside the sachet?

units.rawText: I remember—it's lilac, just like the one you have.
units.displayText: I remember—it's lilac, just like the one you have.

spans.text: I remember—it's lilac, just like the one you have.

units.rawText: Correct. Next, do you know what the lilac flower means?
units.displayText: Correct. Next, do you know what the lilac flower means?

spans.text: Correct. Next, do you know what the lilac flower means?

units.rawText: From what I've learned, flowers often have different meanings. If I remember correctly, lilac could mean...
units.displayText: From what I've learned, flowers often have different meanings. If I remember correctly, lilac could mean...

spans.text: From what I've learned, flowers often have different meanings. If I remember correctly, lilac could mean...

units.rawText: Shh. It's not the time to reveal the answer yet.
units.displayText: Shh. It's not the time to reveal the answer yet.

spans.text: Shh. It's not the time to reveal the answer yet.

units.rawText: I'm sure you're smart enough to read my heart and choose the one I entrusted you with, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: I'm sure you're smart enough to read my heart and choose the one I entrusted you with, {교수}.

spans.text: I'm sure you're smart enough to read my heart and choose the one I entrusted you with,

units.rawText: But for now... hold onto that answer until you come back safely.
units.displayText: But for now... hold onto that answer until you come back safely.

spans.text: But for now... hold onto that answer until you come back safely.

units.rawText: [Warning! Irregular Agent detected!]
units.displayText: [Warning! Irregular Agent detected!]

spans.text: [Warning! Irregular Agent detected!]

units.rawText: [Proceed with protocols... Extermination sequence activated.]
units.displayText: [Proceed with protocols... Extermination sequence activated.]

spans.text: [Proceed with protocols... Extermination sequence activated.]

units.rawText: Aargh! Why are Sanctifiers here?!
units.displayText: Aargh! Why are Sanctifiers here?!

spans.text: Aargh! Why are Sanctifiers here?!

units.rawText: I've been here before and never saw a single Sanctifier then!
units.displayText: I've been here before and never saw a single Sanctifier then!

spans.text: I've been here before and never saw a single Sanctifier then!

units.rawText: ...Looks like this area is now part of their patrol route. I must inform everyone back at the Oasis.
units.displayText: ...Looks like this area is now part of their patrol route. I must inform everyone back at the Oasis.

spans.text: ...Looks like this area is now part of their patrol route. I must inform everyone back at the Oasis.

units.rawText: Hey, you should be thinking about how we're gonna get away from this!
units.displayText: Hey, you should be thinking about how we're gonna get away from this!

spans.text: Hey, you should be thinking about how we're gonna get away from this!

units.rawText: Sol pushes me away, blocking a Sanctifier's attack with her sword.
units.displayText: Sol pushes me away, blocking a Sanctifier's attack with her sword.

spans.text: Sol pushes me away, blocking a Sanctifier's attack with her sword.

units.rawText: Do you have any good plans in that noggin of yours? They don't seem to be large in numbers, and we now have plenty of operands. If you want to fight right here, I'm all in!
units.displayText: Do you have any good plans in that noggin of yours? They don't seem to be large in numbers, and we now have plenty of operands. If you want to fight right here, I'm all in!

spans.text: Do you have any good plans in that noggin of yours? They don't seem to be large in numbers, and we now have plenty of operands. If you want to fight right here, I'm all in!

units.rawText: ...No, forget it.
units.displayText: ...No, forget it.

spans.text: ...No, forget it.

units.rawText: I know what you're capable of, but we've already met our resource quota for today. There's no reason to engage them here.
units.displayText: I know what you're capable of, but we've already met our resource quota for today. There's no reason to engage them here.

spans.text: I know what you're capable of, but we've already met our resource quota for today. There's no reason to engage them here.

units.rawText: We'll be on the run, then? I'm also good with that!
units.displayText: We'll be on the run, then? I'm also good with that!

spans.text: We'll be on the run, then? I'm also good with that!

units.rawText: Eat this!
units.displayText: Eat this!

spans.text: Eat this!

units.rawText: A swift strike slams into the ground, sending dirt flying and blinding the enemies in a veil of dust.
units.displayText: A swift strike slams into the ground, sending dirt flying and blinding the enemies in a veil of dust.

spans.text: A swift strike slams into the ground, sending dirt flying and blinding the enemies in a veil of dust.

units.rawText: Alright, that should earn us some time... Professor, where are we running to?
units.displayText: Alright, that should earn us some time... Professor, where are we running to?

spans.text: Alright, that should earn us some time... Professor, where are we running to?

units.rawText: ...Sol, I think we should split.
units.displayText: ...Sol, I think we should split.

spans.text: ...Sol, I think we should split.

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: Wait, wait! Professor, you're a sitting duck for the Sanctifiers! Who's going to keep you safe if we split up?
units.displayText: Wait, wait! Professor, you're a sitting duck for the Sanctifiers! Who's going to keep you safe if we split up?

spans.text: Wait, wait! Professor, you're a sitting duck for the Sanctifiers! Who's going to keep you safe if we split up?

units.rawText: Right now, this is the best plan with the highest chance of success. The resources are weighing us down, we won't be able to outrun them together.
units.displayText: Right now, this is the best plan with the highest chance of success. The resources are weighing us down, we won't be able to outrun them together.

spans.text: Right now, this is the best plan with the highest chance of success. The resources are weighing us down, we won't be able to outrun them together.

units.rawText: I understand what you're trying to say, but...
units.displayText: I understand what you're trying to say, but...

spans.text: I understand what you're trying to say, but...

units.rawText: About the combat part... You don't need to worry about that.
units.displayText: About the combat part... You don't need to worry about that.

spans.text: About the combat part... You don't need to worry about that.

units.rawText: My fingers rest on the sachet tucked close to my chest.
units.displayText: My fingers rest on the sachet tucked close to my chest.

spans.text: My fingers rest on the sachet tucked close to my chest.

units.rawText: I've got a secret weapon ready for emergencies.
units.displayText: I've got a secret weapon ready for emergencies.

spans.text: I've got a secret weapon ready for emergencies.

units.rawText: Hah? I don't get what you mean...
units.displayText: Hah? I don't get what you mean...

spans.text: Hah? I don't get what you mean...

units.rawText: Save your questions for later!
units.displayText: Save your questions for later!

spans.text: Save your questions for later!

units.rawText: The dust cloud is clearing. Sol, prepare to retreat. Rendezvous at these coordinates!
units.displayText: The dust cloud is clearing. Sol, prepare to retreat. Rendezvous at these coordinates!

spans.text: The dust cloud is clearing. Sol, prepare to retreat. Rendezvous at these coordinates!

units.rawText: Hah... Hah...!
units.displayText: Hah... Hah...!

spans.text: Hah... Hah...!

units.rawText: Now I should be rid of them. Luckily there weren't that many.
units.displayText: Now I should be rid of them. Luckily there weren't that many.

spans.text: Now I should be rid of them. Luckily there weren't that many.

units.rawText: I look back, scanning the surroundings repeatedly before finally releasing a long, relieved sigh.
units.displayText: I look back, scanning the surroundings repeatedly before finally releasing a long, relieved sigh.

spans.text: I look back, scanning the surroundings repeatedly before finally releasing a long, relieved sigh.

units.rawText: Are you okay, <cmdr>?
units.displayText: Are you okay, {교수}?

spans.text: Are you okay,

units.rawText: Woah! ...Sangoma?
units.displayText: Woah! ...Sangoma?

spans.text: Woah! ...Sangoma?

units.rawText: With nary a sound, the familiar purple-haired Doll emerges from behind me.
units.displayText: With nary a sound, the familiar purple-haired Doll emerges from behind me.

spans.text: With nary a sound, the familiar purple-haired Doll emerges from behind me.

units.rawText: Huff... I'm fine. When did you come? I didn't send you an SOS...
units.displayText: Huff... I'm fine. When did you come? I didn't send you an SOS...

spans.text: Huff... I'm fine. When did you come? I didn't send you an SOS...

units.rawText: I was concerned, so I quietly followed you. I'm glad to see you safe.
units.displayText: I was concerned, so I quietly followed you. I'm glad to see you safe.

spans.text: I was concerned, so I quietly followed you. I'm glad to see you safe.

units.rawText: You told me to calm down and not worry, but you were the one that was worried the most. I'm fine, not a scratch. Let's rendezvous with Sol.
units.displayText: You told me to calm down and not worry, but you were the one that was worried the most. I'm fine, not a scratch. Let's rendezvous with Sol.

spans.text: You told me to calm down and not worry, but you were the one that was worried the most. I'm fine, not a scratch. Let's rendezvous with Sol.

units.rawText: Before we do that, I've got a more enticing plan.
units.displayText: Before we do that, I've got a more enticing plan.

spans.text: Before we do that, I've got a more enticing plan.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, since we're already here, why don't we check out that place?
units.displayText: {교수}, since we're already here, why don't we check out that place?

spans.text: , since we're already here, why don't we check out that place?

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: As if summoned by her will, a sprawling, pitch-black city reveals itself from the shroud of sands, and seemingly welcomes us two strangers.
units.displayText: As if summoned by her will, a sprawling, pitch-black city reveals itself from the shroud of sands, and seemingly welcomes us two strangers.

spans.text: As if summoned by her will, a sprawling, pitch-black city reveals itself from the shroud of sands, and seemingly welcomes us two strangers.

units.rawText: The Pierides Sector... I didn't realize we had gotten this close.
units.displayText: The Pierides Sector... I didn't realize we had gotten this close.

spans.text: The Pierides Sector... I didn't realize we had gotten this close.

units.rawText: The Pierides Sector should have plenty of operands in reserve to help with the Oasis' shortage. If we can't figure out the Sanctifiers' plans for now, we might as well try something new.
units.displayText: The Pierides Sector should have plenty of operands in reserve to help with the Oasis' shortage. If we can't figure out the Sanctifiers' plans for now, we might as well try something new.

spans.text: The Pierides Sector should have plenty of operands in reserve to help with the Oasis' shortage. If we can't figure out the Sanctifiers' plans for now, we might as well try something new.

units.rawText: Why don't we go check it out? I'll cover your escape if there's any danger.
units.displayText: Why don't we go check it out? I'll cover your escape if there's any danger.

spans.text: Why don't we go check it out? I'll cover your escape if there's any danger.

units.rawText: Acquiring resources from other sectors... That's a good train of thought, but we'll hold off on it for now.
units.displayText: Acquiring resources from other sectors... That's a good train of thought, but we'll hold off on it for now.

spans.text: Acquiring resources from other sectors... That's a good train of thought, but we'll hold off on it for now.

units.rawText: Today's fieldwork uncovered a new resource deposit, enough to address our supply concerns for the time being. Now, I must regroup with Sol soon, and analyze the Sanctifiers' abnormal behavior when we get back.
units.displayText: Today's fieldwork uncovered a new resource deposit, enough to address our supply concerns for the time being. Now, I must regroup with Sol soon, and analyze the Sanctifiers' abnormal behavior when we get back.

spans.text: Today's fieldwork uncovered a new resource deposit, enough to address our supply concerns for the time being. Now, I must regroup with Sol soon, and analyze the Sanctifiers' abnormal behavior when we get back.

units.rawText: ...Fine. But Pierides should be a good option if you're going to form relationships with other sectors.
units.displayText: ...Fine. But Pierides should be a good option if you're going to form relationships with other sectors.

spans.text: ...Fine. But Pierides should be a good option if you're going to form relationships with other sectors.

units.rawText: I see someone coming. See you later.
units.displayText: I see someone coming. See you later.

spans.text: I see someone coming. See you later.

units.rawText: Before I get to ask, Sangoma's silhouette once again fades away into the omnipresent shroud of sand.
units.displayText: Before I get to ask, Sangoma's silhouette once again fades away into the omnipresent shroud of sand.

spans.text: Before I get to ask, Sangoma's silhouette once again fades away into the omnipresent shroud of sand.

units.rawText: Professor! Professor, are you okay?!
units.displayText: Professor! Professor, are you okay?!

spans.text: Professor! Professor, are you okay?!

units.rawText: I'm fine. How are you doing, Sol? Are you hurt?
units.displayText: I'm fine. How are you doing, Sol? Are you hurt?

spans.text: I'm fine. How are you doing, Sol? Are you hurt?

units.rawText: They were very pesky but I made it out somehow... Hm? Professor, were you just talking to someone else?
units.displayText: They were very pesky but I made it out somehow... Hm? Professor, were you just talking to someone else?

spans.text: They were very pesky but I made it out somehow... Hm? Professor, were you just talking to someone else?

units.rawText: ...Nah, you're just imagining things.
units.displayText: ...Nah, you're just imagining things.

spans.text: ...Nah, you're just imagining things.

units.rawText: Let's go home, Sol. To our Oasis.
units.displayText: Let's go home, Sol. To our Oasis.

spans.text: Let's go home, Sol. To our Oasis.

units.rawText: Yeah!
units.displayText: Yeah!

spans.text: Yeah!

units.rawText: December 16th, Oasis Ops Room
units.displayText: December 16th, Oasis Ops Room

spans.text: December 16th, Oasis Ops Room

units.rawText: ...Sometimes, I feel humbled just looking at how far the Oasis has come.
units.displayText: ...Sometimes, I feel humbled just looking at how far the Oasis has come.

spans.text: ...Sometimes, I feel humbled just looking at how far the Oasis has come.

units.rawText: Hm? Why are you getting so sentimental all of a sudden? You're starting to sound like an old grandma.
units.displayText: Hm? Why are you getting so sentimental all of a sudden? You're starting to sound like an old grandma.

spans.text: Hm? Why are you getting so sentimental all of a sudden? You're starting to sound like an old grandma.

units.rawText: Old models do as old models do... Watching the Oasis become what it is today really makes me feel how time flies.
units.displayText: Old models do as old models do... Watching the Oasis become what it is today really makes me feel how time flies.

spans.text: Old models do as old models do... Watching the Oasis become what it is today really makes me feel how time flies.

units.rawText: Not just the Oasis, I also feel that when I look at you from time to time.
units.displayText: Not just the Oasis, I also feel that when I look at you from time to time.

spans.text: Not just the Oasis, I also feel that when I look at you from time to time.

units.rawText: How so?
units.displayText: How so?

spans.text: How so?

units.rawText: You see, recently you've had fewer long nights, and the documents on your desk are much more organized.
units.displayText: You see, recently you've had fewer long nights, and the documents on your desk are much more organized.

spans.text: You see, recently you've had fewer long nights, and the documents on your desk are much more organized.

units.rawText: You're even eating three proper meals a day now, and you look much healthier than before.
units.displayText: You're even eating three proper meals a day now, and you look much healthier than before.

spans.text: You're even eating three proper meals a day now, and you look much healthier than before.

units.rawText: Ah, how come you see things about me that I don't even notice myself?
units.displayText: Ah, how come you see things about me that I don't even notice myself?

spans.text: Ah, how come you see things about me that I don't even notice myself?

units.rawText: Of course I can. Just how long do you think I've been watching you?
units.displayText: Of course I can. Just how long do you think I've been watching you?

spans.text: Of course I can. Just how long do you think I've been watching you?

units.rawText: She rises from the chair, passes by my seat, and makes her way to the window.
units.displayText: She rises from the chair, passes by my seat, and makes her way to the window.

spans.text: She rises from the chair, passes by my seat, and makes her way to the window.

units.rawText: Watching you become more mature brings me joy, but it also leaves me humbled.
units.displayText: Watching you become more mature brings me joy, but it also leaves me humbled.

spans.text: Watching you become more mature brings me joy, but it also leaves me humbled.

units.rawText: Maybe, it's about time I...
units.displayText: Maybe, it's about time I...

spans.text: Maybe, it's about time I...

units.rawText: Sangoma doesn't finish her sentence. She turns back to the window, quietly glancing at the Oasis through it.
units.displayText: Sangoma doesn't finish her sentence. She turns back to the window, quietly glancing at the Oasis through it.

spans.text: Sangoma doesn't finish her sentence. She turns back to the window, quietly glancing at the Oasis through it.

units.rawText: Sangoma, there's something I want to discuss with you.
units.displayText: Sangoma, there's something I want to discuss with you.

spans.text: Sangoma, there's something I want to discuss with you.

units.rawText: Hm? What's with the sudden seriousness?
units.displayText: Hm? What's with the sudden seriousness?

spans.text: Hm? What's with the sudden seriousness?

units.rawText: I know you have many secrets, and you don't share the same values as we do.
units.displayText: I know you have many secrets, and you don't share the same values as we do.

spans.text: I know you have many secrets, and you don't share the same values as we do.

units.rawText: But I don't mind any of it. I just want everyone at the Oasis to know about you, to recognize all your contributions behind the scenes.
units.displayText: But I don't mind any of it. I just want everyone at the Oasis to know about you, to recognize all your contributions behind the scenes.

spans.text: But I don't mind any of it. I just want everyone at the Oasis to know about you, to recognize all your contributions behind the scenes.

units.rawText: That said, I don't want you to stay in the shadows forever.
units.displayText: That said, I don't want you to stay in the shadows forever.

spans.text: That said, I don't want you to stay in the shadows forever.

units.rawText: I extend my hand and my invitation to the Doll in front of me.
units.displayText: I extend my hand and my invitation to the Doll in front of me.

spans.text: I extend my hand and my invitation to the Doll in front of me.

units.rawText: Do you wish to join the Oasis and stay by my side?
units.displayText: Do you wish to join the Oasis and stay by my side?

spans.text: Do you wish to join the Oasis and stay by my side?

units.rawText: You can be surprisingly playful at times, Professor.
units.displayText: You can be surprisingly playful at times, Professor.

spans.text: You can be surprisingly playful at times, Professor.

units.rawText: She doesn't take my hand but shakes her head.
units.displayText: She doesn't take my hand but shakes her head.

spans.text: She doesn't take my hand but shakes her head.

units.rawText: As for now, I cannot accept your invitation.
units.displayText: As for now, I cannot accept your invitation.

spans.text: As for now, I cannot accept your invitation.

units.rawText: ...Do you mind telling me why?
units.displayText: ...Do you mind telling me why?

spans.text: ...Do you mind telling me why?

units.rawText: You'll know when the time comes.
units.displayText: You'll know when the time comes.

spans.text: You'll know when the time comes.

units.rawText: The purple-haired Doll smiles as she finishes her sentence.
units.displayText: The purple-haired Doll smiles as she finishes her sentence.

spans.text: The purple-haired Doll smiles as she finishes her sentence.

units.rawText: But I'm very happy about your invitation. I've been waiting for it ever since the first day I came to the Oasis.
units.displayText: But I'm very happy about your invitation. I've been waiting for it ever since the first day I came to the Oasis.

spans.text: But I'm very happy about your invitation. I've been waiting for it ever since the first day I came to the Oasis.

units.rawText: Although I can't say yes, I've long prepared what I have to tell you for this moment.
units.displayText: Although I can't say yes, I've long prepared what I have to tell you for this moment.

spans.text: Although I can't say yes, I've long prepared what I have to tell you for this moment.

units.rawText: She suddenly steps close to my side, her voice a soft whisper in my ear. The familiar scent of lilac gently drifts in the air.
units.displayText: She suddenly steps close to my side, her voice a soft whisper in my ear. The familiar scent of lilac gently drifts in the air.

spans.text: She suddenly steps close to my side, her voice a soft whisper in my ear. The familiar scent of lilac gently drifts in the air.
